[package]
name = "parquetrs"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
parquet = "55.0.0"
serde = { version = "1.0.157", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = {version = "1.0.94", features = ["raw_value"] }
serde_derive = "1.0.157"
arrow = "55.0.0"
arrow-schema = "55.0.0"
indexmap = { version = "2.0", features = ["serde"] }
chrono = "0.4.41"
simd-json = { version = "0.14.3", features = ["serde"] }

[lib]
crate-type = ["cdylib"]

[profile.release]
debug = false
opt-level = 3          # maximum optimization for speed
lto = true             # enable link-time optimization
codegen-units = 1      # better optimization at the cost of slower compile
overflow-checks = false # skip integer overflow checks
